commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

step.description: The LLM step to mint a session for.

subject.description: What the artefact is for, as the step names it: a bank's id for the Memory bank step; none when absent.

variant.description: Which of an LLM step's prompts a minted session starts with: first, which authors the step's artefact, or revise, which revises the one there.

account.description: The account the session's runs use; the environment's default account when absent.

model.description: The model the session's runs use, one the account offers; the strongest of the default model family when absent.

effort.description: The reasoning effort of the first run; the default effort when absent and the model takes it.
